translated_title: "I'm Going to Beat the Hell Out of Marina," Jaime Bonilla Says About the Governor in New Video
original_title: "Le voy a romper su madre a Marina", dice Jaime Bonilla de Gobernadora en nuevo VIDEO
author: Redacción/SinEmbargo
meta_description: The video, leaked by outlet Pie de Nota, shows former governor Jaime Bonilla threatening Marina del Pilar, Baja California's sitting Morena governor, amid a 2022 feud.
